case: Scenario 2 - children aged 5 to 14 and education facilities

sample.method: cell probability proportional to count; uniform point inside selected cell; reject outside Hanoi

limitations: OSM school capacities are unavailable; capacity remains missing.
Samples are Monte Carlo draws from modeled raster counts, not observed individual children.
GADM boundary vintage differs from WorldPop 2020.
Merged rows carry namespaced ids osm_<type>_<id>; real OSM element type/id stay recoverable and cannot collide with baseline numeric ids.
Added schools are unverified vaccination-site CANDIDATES; polygon centers are not gates; capacities remain missing.
Rows flagged outside_gadm41_historical_boundary in the merge log are kept: the Overpass Hanoi boundary is the inclusion source and the GADM 4.1 vintage differs.

baseline.source: HOT OSM education facilities export (points only) via HDX, ODbL 1.0 — the historical 332-row baseline; original numeric facility_ids unchanged

merge.dedup_policy: exact OSM node id, else identical normalized Vietnamese name within 150 m of the SAME baseline row; nearest-location alone is never a duplicate reason (the inventory match_status many-to-one proximity matches are informational only); genuinely separate same-name branches farther than 150 m are preserved
